title: PIM-SM Rendezvous Point Not Learning Groups
symptoms: PIM neighbors are established between routers
The RP is configured and reachable
The RP shows no group entries in its mroute table
rootCause: The RP address is configured on some routers but not all. PIM routers that do not know the RP address cannot send PIM Register messages, so the RP never learns about active multicast sources.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the PIM RP mapping configured on a router?
steps.hint: If the output is empty, the RP is not configured on this router.

steps.prompt: Which command shows PIM neighbors and confirms adjacencies?
steps.hint: PIM neighbors must be up before any multicast forwarding can occur.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the multicast routing table on the RP?
steps.hint: Group entries should appear here when sources are active.
